authorization: User approved reviewed recommendations and continuation within the proposed budget.

resource_accounting.training_related: Cumulative feature derivation/audit, numerical learning checks, model initialization/loading, optimization, validation/selection and action-test evaluation; failed attempts and interrupted runs remain counted. Source implementation and non-learning unit tests are recorded separately.
resource_accounting.collection: Timed and counted separately; no more than 600 new full corpus matches including diagnostic, validation, test and optional aggregation.
resource_accounting.evaluation: At most four 30-block development campaigns and one conditional fixed-budget confirmation; repeated paired wall executions are not independent matches.
resource_accounting.benchmark: Worker sweeps, process setup/drain and sustained benchmark share the 1800-second ceiling; no benchmark trajectories enter training.
resource_accounting.stops: Cooperative limits with reserved save/drain overhead; resource-limited comparisons are incomplete, never silently promoted. No automatic budget extension.

collection.focal_seat: balance within each group; only focal actor/target decisions saved
collection.test_policy: Integrity and feature-alignment checks allowed; model predictions and performance on test withheld until final checkpoint is frozen.

training.initialization: Explicitly copy same-name/same-shape raw-model initial tensors into feature models per seed; record shared tensor hashes. Additional feature parameters are initialized from a separate declared seeded stream. Preserve paired sampling streams.
training.checkpoint_selection: Fixed stratified validation indices: maximize equal-stratum mean optional DISCARD best-set agreement, then minimize equal-stratum shanten-worsening rate, then minimize equal-stratum optional policy KL.
training.recipe_selection: Evaluate each selected checkpoint on full validation. Average the same three equal-stratum metrics across both seeds; lexicographic order as above, fixed recipe order breaks exact ties. Include any completed eligible contingent recipe.
training.final_checkpoint: Primary seed checkpoint of winning recipe, frozen before any test predictions or development match outcomes. No seed substitution after outcomes.
training.budget_planning: Measure fixed tiny-fit/check workloads first. If projected required comparisons cannot fit, reduce a common update ceiling before formal runs; otherwise preserve 20000. Reserve at least 120 seconds for final validation/test/checkpoint work. Skip optional runs unless both can fit.

contingent.base: Best full-validation feature-assisted rank setting, averaged over both seeds
contingent.priority_1: Student-focal optional-discard error minus teacher-focal error exceeds 0.02 after averaging per-stratum row rates across both seeds: collect up to 300 new training matches using frozen primary-seed base behavior and teacher queries; train both seeds from paired initialization on a declared 50:50 original/student-row mixture at the common update count.
contingent.priority_2: Otherwise, equal-shanten lost-ukeire rate exceeds 0.02 on full validation averaged equally across strata/seeds AND exceeds 0.01 on fixed frozen-model training samples AND tiny-fit/alignment checks pass: test a remaining-hand candidate encoder with two seeds, no data change.
contingent.otherwise: No contingent run; thresholds allocate experiments, not significance or causal claims.
contingent.controls: Reuse corresponding completed base runs; no extra control runs or extra continuation updates. Exact conditional architecture/data manifest frozen before its training.

evaluation.candidate_recipes: Top two eligible recipes by full-validation two-seed score, each seed once; common development blocks. If fewer than two eligible complete recipes, report incomplete scope.

confirmation.method: Fixed-count one-sided normal approximation over independent paired block means
confirmation.futility: Final candidate pilot mean <= -0.10: do not confirm
confirmation.over_cap: Inconclusive; do not underpower a claimed pass
confirmation.reuse: No tuning or candidate switching using confirmation blocks

benchmark.escalation: Try next worker count only if preceding count improves throughput without resource issues
benchmark.keep: Per-match compact identities/seeds/outcomes/failure hashes and time-window/cost/memory summaries, with replay evidence for failures; no training corpus
